subject: Installation Trouble channel and job features

messages.author: c0ac1a2ca1463b3a
messages.subject: Installation Trouble channel and job features
parts:
I just installed Nvim-R for the first time. On startup it stays I need the +channel and +job features enabled. I know they're not there based on :version. I'm not sure how to enable them. Googling did not help.

Thanks

messages.author: b256a2742aacd200
messages.subject: Re: Installation Trouble channel and job features
parts: The features are either enabled or disabled at compile time, and they are enabled by default. If your Vim does not have these feature, probably, it is too old (more than one month old). You have to either compile Vim yourself or find a binary that is new enough. As the complete message says, Vim must be >= 7.4.1579.
